n7a999ce6fc.headline: Trump envoy says officials working 'very, very hard' on ending Russia-Ukraine war
n7a999ce6fc.summary: US special envoy Keith Kellogg said in Kyiv that officials are working very hard on efforts to end the three-year war between Russia and Ukraine. The comments were made on Monday.
n7a999ce6fc.why: The Russia-Ukraine war affects European energy, grain and commodity markets, and any peace process shapes sanctions and reconstruction investment.

nb59fea60a5.headline: FG Approves Medium-Term Debt Strategy, Pegs Debt-To-GDP Ratio At 60% By 2027
nb59fea60a5.summary: Nigeria has approved its 2024–2027 medium-term debt strategy. It caps the debt-to-GDP ratio at 60% by 2027 to strengthen sustainability and stability.
nb59fea60a5.why: Medium-term debt strategies set borrowing limits and funding plans, which influence sovereign bond spreads and investor confidence in an emerging market.

n6b81f69414.headline: Streeting vows not to let drug firms ‘rip off’ taxpayers after pricing row
n6b81f69414.summary: UK Health Secretary Wes Streeting left talks with the pharmaceutical sector after both sides failed to agree changes to a drug pricing deal. He vowed not to let drug firms rip off taxpayers.
n6b81f69414.why: The UK pricing scheme sets what the NHS pays for branded medicines, so changes directly affect revenues of pharmaceutical companies selling into the British market.

n7bf81fc527.headline: ICG Posts S$21.2 Million Net Profit for 1H2025, Driven by 51% Revenue Growth
n7bf81fc527.summary: Mainboard-listed International Cement Group reported a S$21.2 million net profit for 1H2025. Revenue grew 51% over the period.
n7bf81fc527.why: International Cement Group is a Singapore-listed cement company, so its results reflect demand from construction markets in the region.

ne344a0eb39.headline: Hospitality hit hardest as nearly 90,000 jobs lost after budget tax rises
ne344a0eb39.summary: The UK hospitality sector has lost almost 90,000 jobs since the autumn budget, with industry leaders warning that tax rises are damaging pubs, restaurants and hotels.
ne344a0eb39.why: Hospitality is a large employer in the UK economy, and its margins are sensitive to tax, wage and energy costs. Weakness in the sector feeds into consumer spending and employment data.

n907624d3b5.headline: Venezuela: Turkish Investors to Take Over State-Owned Sugar Mills Under ‘Strategic Alliances’
n907624d3b5.summary: Venezuela is letting Turkish investors take over state-owned sugar mills under strategic alliances, as Caracas relies more on the private sector to revive production in nationalized countryside companies.
n907624d3b5.why: Private-sector partnerships can attract capital and expertise to state-run agricultural assets. Foreign investment in Venezuela carries significant political and currency risk.

n1e82b98ce1.headline: First step for rail reform but it needs swift implementation - BLSA
n1e82b98ce1.summary: New rail operators are set to move about 20 million tonnes more cargo annually from 2026/27 and unlock R100 billion in rolling stock investment, BLSA said.
n1e82b98ce1.why: Rail capacity affects freight costs and logistics for mining and export industries, which are central to South Africa's economy.

nbdce818ee1.headline: 5 pc home deposit scheme brought forward three months
nbdce818ee1.summary: The Federal Government is bringing forward the start date of its 5% home deposit scheme by three months, to help more Australians enter the property market faster.
nbdce818ee1.why: Deposit schemes lower the upfront cost of buying a home, which affects housing demand, lending activity and property prices.

na03803259b.headline: Half of UK job losses in hospitality, say bosses
na03803259b.summary: A hospitality lobby group says half of UK job losses are in the sector and calls for urgent action to lower taxes, while the government says it is helping establishments.
na03803259b.why: Hospitality is a large employer in the UK, and labour costs and taxes directly affect pub, restaurant and hotel operators.

n884149c0c2.headline: Oman’s new Golden Visa to open doors to business ownership and long-term residency
n884149c0c2.summary: Oman will launch its Golden Visa programme on August 31 to attract foreign investors, alongside support for high-performing Omani firms and planned digital trade reforms.
n884149c0c2.why: Investor residency programmes are used by Gulf states to attract foreign capital and business ownership into their economies.

nb385c4078a.headline: Fed's Williams says low neutral interest rate era is not over
nb385c4078a.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said the era of persistently low underlying interest rates does not appear to be over, based on his reading of the data.
nb385c4078a.why: The neutral rate is the level that neither stimulates nor restrains the economy, and it anchors expectations for Federal Reserve policy and Treasury yields.

n7149cfc83e.headline: Pakistan to Seek Deferral of 177 LNG Shipments From Qatar
n7149cfc83e.summary: Pakistan will ask Qatar to defer 177 LNG cargoes over the next five years after a sharp decline in domestic gas consumption.
n7149cfc83e.why: Qatar is one of the world's largest LNG exporters, and changes in buyer schedules affect global gas supply and contract volumes.

nfe9285af76.headline: Orange Egypt and Enjaz team up for Saudi money transfer offer
nfe9285af76.summary: Orange Egypt has signed an exclusive money transfer partnership with Enjaz Payment Services, which the release describes as one of the largest fintech companies in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East.
nfe9285af76.why: Orange Egypt is the Egyptian unit of French telecom group Orange, and mobile money and payments partnerships are a growing revenue line for telecom operators.

ne83b1f1827.headline: The Real Reason Why Turkey Is Still Blocking KRG Oil
ne83b1f1827.summary: Talk of restarting Kurdistan Region of Iraq exports via Ceyhan is premature, according to OilPrice.com, because Turkey has not agreed. The Kirkuk–Ceyhan line has remained shut since March 25, 2023.
ne83b1f1827.why: The Kirkuk–Ceyhan pipeline is a key export route for northern Iraqi crude, so its status affects regional oil supply and Iraqi government revenues.

n74c302fc46.headline: Farmers warn of crisis as poll shows 80% fear for survival and none back Labour
n74c302fc46.summary: A new poll shows 80% of farmers fear their businesses will not survive the next decade. Many are pausing investment or considering selling land amid Labour's inheritance tax reforms.
n74c302fc46.why: Inheritance tax rules affect how farm land and businesses are passed on, which shapes investment, land values and agricultural supply in the UK.

n95e7152aca.headline: South Korean President Lee to meet with Trump in Washington on Monday
n95e7152aca.summary: The US and South Korean presidents will meet in Washington on Monday. They will discuss modernising their 71-year-old alliance and fleshing out a trade deal reached last month.
n95e7152aca.why: South Korea is a major exporter of semiconductors, autos and electronics, so US trade terms directly affect Korean industry. The bilateral alliance also shapes regional security and supply chains.

n16f5e52fc8.headline: Scentre Upgrades Annual Distribution Guidance -- Update
n16f5e52fc8.summary: Scentre upgraded its annual distribution guidance, citing strengthening tailwinds for shopping mall owners including falling interest rates and stabilising property valuations.
n16f5e52fc8.why: Scentre Group owns and manages Westfield-branded shopping centres in Australia and New Zealand, and its distributions matter to income-focused investors.

nfbd55c70ff.headline: The Stockholm Accord and the Future of Sino-American Trade - FPIF
nfbd55c70ff.summary: A Foreign Policy In Focus analysis says a quiet thaw has taken place between Beijing and Washington, with the Stockholm Accord discussed in the context of future Sino-American trade.
nfbd55c70ff.why: US-China trade relations shape tariffs, supply chains and global growth, affecting many listed companies and currencies. Policy shifts between the two largest economies are closely watched by investors.

nd10cc159e9.headline: Farmers respond to government's report into banking competition
nd10cc159e9.summary: Farming groups said the government's report on banking competition vindicates concerns the farming sector has held for some time.
nd10cc159e9.why: Banking competition affects the cost and availability of credit to farmers, a key borrower group in New Zealand's export economy.

n45f66adf56.headline: Saab Rises on New Billion-Krona Order, OMXS30 Index Down 0.4 Percent
n45f66adf56.summary: Saab secured a new billion-krona order from Thailand. The OMXS30 index was down 0.4% at midday in Stockholm, mirroring weaker European bourses.
n45f66adf56.why: Saab is a Swedish defence and aerospace group, and large export orders shape its revenue outlook.

impacts.name: OMXS30
impacts.why: The Stockholm benchmark index was down 0.4% at midday, in line with European markets.

nf074b46dc2.headline: Meta invests in SC solar as utilities expect more clean energy-conscious firms to finance projects
nf074b46dc2.summary: Meta's funding helps pay for a $100 million solar project in Orangeburg County that otherwise would have cost power companies too much to build. Utilities expect similar deals.
nf074b46dc2.why: Meta is a large technology company whose data centres require substantial electricity, so it increasingly funds clean power supply.

n20ec729b54.headline: RBI has not lost sight of growth amid tariffs, geopolitical uncertainties: Malhotra - OrissaPOST
n20ec729b54.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said corporates and banks must work together to boost investment amid tariff and geopolitical uncertainty. He stressed the central bank's growth objective.
n20ec729b54.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets monetary policy for India, and its stance on growth affects Indian rates, the rupee and equities.

n8eb1842d1d.headline: Economy in 'continuity of crisis', people's well-being must be prioritised: Hossain Zillur
n8eb1842d1d.summary: PPRC Chairman Hossain Zillur Rahman said Bangladesh's economy faces a 'continuity of crisis' and policymakers should prioritise household well-being. He presented the organisation's latest research report.
n8eb1842d1d.why: Bangladesh is a major garment exporter and a large emerging economy whose macroeconomic stability matters for regional trade and investors.

n34aa77ee5a.headline: BWS owner cuts dividend as Aussies avoid booze splurge
n34aa77ee5a.summary: Endeavour Group, owner of Dan Murphy's and BWS, cut its dividend. The company blamed subdued sales on cost-of-living pressures.
n34aa77ee5a.why: Endeavour Group is Australia's largest liquor retailer and a major ASX-listed consumer company. Its dividend and sales trends are read as signals of household discretionary spending.

n6f0d5451fc.headline: Fortescue Annual Profit Falls 41% On Weaker Iron-Ore Prices -- Update
n6f0d5451fc.summary: Fortescue reported a 41% fall in annual net profit and pared its dividend. The drop reflected lower iron-ore prices as China's property crisis weighed on steel demand.
n6f0d5451fc.why: Fortescue is one of the world's largest iron-ore producers, so its earnings closely track iron-ore prices and Chinese steel demand. Iron ore is a key Australian export.

n95b06d1fa3.headline: Biggest losers from Australia Post move
n95b06d1fa3.summary: Australia Post has decided to suspend deliveries of parcels to the United States. Reports say distinctly Australian goods are among the hardest hit.
n95b06d1fa3.why: Australia Post is the national postal operator, and parcel suspensions affect exporters, online sellers and logistics flows between Australia and the US.

n24f4fb6862.headline: Huawei's most affordable car Shangjie H5 SUV starts pre-sales from 23,600 USD
n24f4fb6862.summary: Huawei's entry-level Shangjie H5 SUV has opened pre-orders starting at $23,600. The vehicle is described as the company's most affordable car.
n24f4fb6862.why: Huawei is a major Chinese technology and telecom company that has expanded into electric vehicles, intensifying competition in China's car market.

ncc3748e48f.headline: New Zealand Post suspends deliveries to US over tariffs
ncc3748e48f.summary: New Zealand Post will deliver only limited letters and important documents such as passports or legal letters to the US. The suspension follows US tariffs.
ncc3748e48f.why: New Zealand Post is the national postal operator, and tariffs on cross-border parcels affect its international business and e-commerce trade.

n59519a29cb.headline: July trade data point to headwinds
n59519a29cb.summary: Malaysia's July exports rose 6.8% year on year to RM140.45 billion, but underlying trends suggest more challenging times ahead for exports and the wider economy.
n59519a29cb.why: Malaysia is a major Southeast Asian exporter of electronics and commodities, so its trade data is a gauge of regional demand and growth.

n9fbe37dd9d.headline: French PM François Bayrou will ask for confidence vote on September 8
n9fbe37dd9d.summary: The IMF is pushing for changes to the State Bank of Pakistan Act, including removing the finance secretary from the board and filling vacant posts.
n9fbe37dd9d.why: The IMF is Pakistan's main lender under its bailout programme, and its conditions shape the central bank's governance and monetary policy credibility.

n3a3d5ee9fb.headline: S&P/TSX composite, U.S. markets give back some of last week's gains amid a reversal
n3a3d5ee9fb.summary: Canada's main stock index fell more than 160 points to close Monday, weighed down by industrial and financial sectors. US stock markets also fell, reversing last week's rally.
n3a3d5ee9fb.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, dominated by banks, energy and materials companies.

impacts.name: S&P/TSX Composite
impacts.why: The index fell more than 160 points, with losses concentrated in industrial and financial sectors.

nc60a7e4a58.headline: China Property Stocks Power Up as Traders Bet on Stimulus
nc60a7e4a58.summary: Chinese property stocks rose sharply at the start of the week as measures to boost home buying in Shanghai reinforced stimulus hopes. Traders expect policymakers to take further support steps.
nc60a7e4a58.why: Real estate is a large share of China's economy, and property developers and banks are heavily exposed to the housing market. Policy support for home buying often moves Chinese property equities.
nc60a7e4a58.why_moved: Measures to boost home buying in Shanghai reinforced stimulus hopes, leading traders to bet on further support from Chinese policymakers.

n1ed1b75ac4.headline: Ethereum and cryptocurrency markets send worrying signs despite last Friday's spike
n1ed1b75ac4.summary: Ethereum fell about 4% from recent highs and bitcoin slipped back to $111,000 after Friday's spike. Market commentary flagged growing correction risks.
n1ed1b75ac4.why: Bitcoin and Ethereum are the two largest crypto assets by market value, and their price swings affect crypto-exposed firms and risk sentiment.
n1ed1b75ac4.why_moved: Ethereum fell about 4% from new highs and bitcoin slipped back after a Friday spike, with markets signalling correction risks.
